faq.q: What are the top localities to buy a residential or industrial plot in Chennai?
faq.a: For residential plots, areas like Guindy, Nungambakkam, and Tambaram stand out as top regions. For industrial plots, localities such as Ambattur, Thirumudivakkam, and Mamandur are prime choices due to their strategic locations and amenities.
